description: Ask AtlantFlow to call a customer back about service. ONLY call when the person explicitly asked to be contacted and gave their name, phone and ZIP. Side effect: creates a lead in AtlantFlow's Housecall Pro CRM and notifies the office; nothing is deleted or overwritten. Not idempotent but protected: repeated identical requests are de-duplicated and rate-limited, so do not retry on success. This is a callback request, not a confirmed appointment. For emergencies the person should call (561) 510-9414 directly.
